item.title: Physics-Informed Residual Deep Learning for Constitutive Modeling of Hot Deformation and Dynamic Recrystallization in a Mo-Rich α+β Titanium Alloy
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Prashil S. Joshi, Diksha Mahadule, Rajesh K. Khatirkar
arXiv:2607.13467v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Accurate constitutive modeling of hot deformation behavior is essential for designing thermomechanical processes in advanced structural alloys. Conventional Arrhenius-type and empirical models do not adequately capture the combined effects of strain hardening, dynamic recovery (DRV), and dynamic recrystallization (DRX) across broad processing conditions. In this study, two Stacked Residual Physics-Informed Neural Networks (STAR-PINNs) were developed to simulate the hot deformation response of a Mo-rich α+β titanium alloy (Ti-6Al-4Mo-1V-0.1Si). The Enhanced STAR-PINN incorporated thermomechanical constitutive constraints, while the DRX-Aware STAR-PINN employed a dual-output architecture to account for recrystallization kinetics. item.description:

item.title: 基于准正规模的电磁散射机器学习知识融合通用框架
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Viktor A. Lilja, Albin J. Svärdsby, Timo Gahlmann, Philippe Tassin
该工作提出一种面向电磁散射的物理约束神经网络框架，将散射矩阵的准正规模展开作为先验知识嵌入模型。神经网络学习散射谱背后的共振结构，并被保证满足能量守恒和因果性，从而提高可靠性和数据效率。作者在光子晶体板和全介质自由形状超表面中展示了显著的数据效率提升，并指出该框架还可手动加入无损性、对称性和模数等问题特定约束。

item.title: 实验室气候预测：面向湿度敏感实验的机器学习决策支持系统
item.description:
📚 Preprints
👤 Lukas Tilch, Maximilian Heumann, Jan Fabian Drexler, Marc Mueller
静电纺丝的可重复性受环境温度和相对湿度显著影响，但这些变量通常事后记录，难以及时预判天气驱动的实验室条件变化。本文提出基于机器学习的决策支持框架，利用本地气象测量、天气预报和室内气候数据预测实验室相对湿度。为保留房间朝向、通风和热缓冲等局域差异，研究分别为同一建筑内四个实验室训练回归模型，并评估1至7天预报时效下的性能和不确定性，同时用日历信息分析工作日与非工作日带来的室内变异。

item.title: 丙烯酸酯共聚物乳液固化盐渍土无侧限抗压强度的试验研究与小波神经网络预测
item.description:
📚 Preprints
👤 Zhu Yan, Yao Yafeng, Yu Xiangjuan
针对滨海氯盐渍土易发生盐胀、冻胀沉降且传统固化材料环境适配性和固化效果不足的问题，本文开发丙烯酸酯共聚物乳液固化剂，并研究掺量、龄期、含盐量和含水率对无侧限抗压强度的影响。红外光谱和扫描电镜用于揭示微观固化机制。由于固化土强度呈非均匀分布、传统模型难以准确表征，作者构建了改进随机小波网络预测模型，并以四个关键因素作为输入变量来预测强度。

arXiv:2601.19105v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We report a comprehensive quantum oscillation study of the prototypical altermagnet CrSb, combining high-field magnetotransport and torque measurements with DFT + U calculations including spin-orbit coupling. Multiple quantum oscillation frequencies were observed and tracked over wide angular ranges. The measured frequency branches are consistently explained by the spin-split Fermi surfaces arising from the altermagnetic electronic structure. Our determined Fermi surface reveals that bands 1 and 2 form closed pockets centered at the A point, rather than the tubular c-axis-open sheets or Γ-centered closed pockets proposed in previous studies. arXiv:2607.13194v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Fermion bound states in the core of a line-shaped vortex of a two-dimensional topological superconductor are investigated. The superconducting pairing potential, described in terms of elliptical coordinates, vanishes along a line defect with the two foci at the endpoints. The superconductivity is induced into a topological insulator via proximity effect with a type II s-wave superconductor. arXiv:2607.13863v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Altermagnets feature symmetry-dictated nontrivial spin splitting in electronic structure promising for next-generation spintronics, yet their ultrafast dynamical manipulation remains largely unexplored. item.description:

Forty kinematic observables are extracted from MINIAOD and MINIAODSIM, cleaned with physics-motivated selections, and reduced to a 37-dimensional feature vector. Five Neural Spline Flows are trained independently to model Standard Model background and mediator-specific DM signal densities.
